object.attr: derived: CF-E37. An option removed through a pull, a merge or a git client turns eq into nothing and ne into everything; MELLON-EDIT-SRS-88 covers only a removal made in Mellon (D-E26).
object.description: If the active filter compares an enumeration attribute with a value that isn't one of the attribute's options, the Document Editor shall report the filter condition instead of applying the filter.
